red_parab_fit.pro


Routines

top source red_parab_fit

SST pipeline

result = red_parab_fit(x, y)

Computes analytical solution to a parabolic fit.

Return value

Returns the 3 coefficients of the parabola: y = cf[0] + cf[1] * x + cf[2] * x^2

Parameters

x in type=array

X values to fit.

y in type=array

Y values to fit.
